name: M.I.R.A
tagline: A background work companion that builds a timeline of your day and answers questions about it by voice.
problem: People spend hours at screens without a clear record of what they actually did.
solution: Observes app usage and focus, captures screenshots for recall, and offers speech or text conversation about your work and the current screen via a global shortcut.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask what you worked on earlier and get a summary.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Gemini API” among 217 submissions.
Works from passive observation rather than manual logging.

lessons: Passive capture removes the logging step users skip.
